name: wtf
description: /wtf sums up where this session stands and what the agent needs from you, in a few plain lines from Haiku, so you can return to a session without rereading it. The agent keeps working

pane.title: Pane
pane.description: Also open the answer in a pane with a re-run key when the session is idle. In the middle of a turn the pane always opens, because Claude Code prints a command's text only when the turn ends
